{{Top|leg}}
An '''Archive station''' was one of a series of installations set up by the [[New Republic Intelligence Service]] in the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] to act as a network of data gathering and collation centers. Dubbed the "[[Archive system]]," it was under the supervision of [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Breslin Drake]]. Around [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] operative known as [[the Wraith]] penetrated one of the stations and caused the collapse of the system.
